hero.lede: Mobile dog grooming that comes to your door in Ballarat. Golden retrievers, border collies and other long or double coats are what Al knows best.

images.heroAlt: Golden retriever sitting on the grass

servicesSub: Everything is done at your place. Book online, or call Al to talk about your dog.

services.title: Wash & dry
services.short: A wash and dry at your door, so there's no car trip to a salon.
services.long: A wash and dry without leaving home. Good between full grooms, or for dogs who just need freshening up.

services.title: Big de-sheds & undercoat removal
services.short: For double coats that drop hair all over the house.
services.long: Undercoat removal and big de-sheds for double-coated dogs. One reviewer calls Al 'the best double coated groomer in Ballarat'.

services.title: Full grooms
services.short: Full grooms, including golden retriever and border collie grooms.
services.long: Full grooms for large dogs with long or double coats. Golden retriever and border collie full grooms are on the list.

services.title: Clips & hygiene tidy-ups
services.short: All-over body clips, hygiene clips and paw/pad trims.
services.long: All-over body clips, hygiene clips and paw/pad trims, done at home.

services.title: Nail trims
services.short: Nail trims, even for dogs who usually won't sit still for them.
services.long: One owner wrote that Al calmed their dog's nerves and she was content getting her nails clipped, 'which was a first for us'.

whyText: Big, long-coated dogs are a lot of work. Al specialises in them and comes to your door.

reviews.text: I think he is the best double coated groomer in Ballarat. He did an excellent groom with my Japanese spitz.
Al calmed our Tilly's nerves, and she was very content getting her nails clipped, which was a first for us.
Top shelf grooming for my big and hairy border collie.
I thought Murphy would be a super difficult groom but Al had him all sorted in an hour. Smells amazing and not a single knot in sight.
Al was fantastic and incredibly gentle with him. The convenience of a mobile service made it so easy for us.
We will definitely be making this a regular booking!

aboutParas: Al's Dog-Wash Ballarat is run by Al (Alex), from Ballarat East.
He specialises in golden retrievers and border collies, plus large dogs with long or double coats: the breeds that take the most time and patience to groom.
The service is mobile, so your dog stays home. Bookings are online 24/7, or call Al on 0400 508 057.
